source.title: Genotype-Phenotype Relationships in the Context of Transcriptional Adaptation and Genetic Robustness

confidence_rationale: Authoritative (Annual Review of Genetics) synthesis establishing that acute perturbation (knockdown) and developmental/from-conception perturbation (knockout) systematically give DISCORDANT phenotypes, and naming the mechanism (transcriptional adaptation / genetic robustness) that makes develop-without a distinct protocol from mature removal. This is the general-form evidence that the two protocols dissociate for a principled reason, not by accident. Held at 0.60 because the mechanism (mRNA-decay-triggered compensation) is molecular-genetic and has no established REE analog -- the epistemic lesson transfers, the mechanism does not.
failure_signatures: The dissociation is driven by a SPECIFIC compensation route (mutant-mRNA decay upregulating related genes); a system lacking that route can show knockdown/knockout AGREEMENT -- so develop-vs-mature dissociation is contingent on the substrate possessing a compensatory capacity, and its absence in REE would predict AGREE regardless of developmental necessity.

Robustness mechanisms can MASK a true loss-of-function during development, so a develop-without arm that reports 'tolerable' may reflect compensation rather than the mechanism being dispensable -- a confound the mature-lesion arm does not share.

mapping.source_claim_statement: Knockdown (acute reagent-based reduction) and knockout (germline, from-conception loss) of the same gene frequently produce contradictory phenotypes; a major cause is transcriptional adaptation, whereby the mutant allele's decaying mRNA upregulates related genes, buffering the developmental system in a way an acute reagent cannot trigger.
mapping.ree_translation: Map knockout (present-absent from the start of development) to Q-088's competitive redevelopment, and knockdown (removed acutely from an already-built system) to mature-state lesion. The review is a domain-general statement that these two protocols routinely disagree, and identifies WHY: a system that develops without a component can recruit compensation that a mature system stripped of the same component cannot. That is a direct argument that REE's expensive develop-without protocol can buy information the mature lesion misses.
mapping.mapping_caveat: The compensating mechanism is molecular (nonsense-mediated-decay-linked upregulation of paralogues); nothing establishes that the REE substrate has any analogous developmental-compensation capacity. The transferable content is the epistemic structure (develop-without and mature-remove are non-interchangeable protocols), not the biology. If REE has no compensation channel, the prior for dissociation weakens.
mapping.source_context: Review across model organisms (zebrafish, mouse, etc.); comparison of RNAi/morpholino/ASO knockdown vs CRISPR/germline knockout; genotype-phenotype discordance.

confidence_components.notes: Top-tier review venue keeps source_quality high; molecular-to-computational transfer is the risk. Weight the epistemic claim (protocols dissociate) heavily, the mechanistic claim lightly.
